falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 60 basis points or more versus the signal-date level within 14 days, or the 10-year US Treasury yield moves 35 basis points or more in either direction inside any 5 trading days while the MOVE index closes above 120.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit or rates forced a regime break that a passive HOLD cannot survive; UNKNOWN is invalidated because the macro shock defined the call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
